summary: Enterprise GDPR privacy controls were reviewed for data inventory coverage, retention planning, RBAC, step-up, tenant scoping, no-store export delivery, delete-request confirmation, billing/legal retention preservation and chained audit event coverage.

scope.processingRole: SaaS processor/operator controls; customer-specific legal terms remain governed by agreement and DPA

controlsVerified.evidence: users, organizations, organization_members, documents, risks, vendors, tasks, audit_events, notifications, subscriptions, billing metadata and logs are mapped in docs/privacy/DATA_INVENTORY.md and src/server/privacy/gdpr.ts.
docs/privacy/DATA_RETENTION_POLICY.md documents active customer data, account data, billing/legal records, security evidence, operational logs and backup handling.
src/app/api/gdpr/export/route.ts requires authentication, active organization, export_data RBAC, entitlement and export_data step-up.
validateRequestedOrganizationScope rejects malformed or different organizationId values before export collection.
noStoreDownload applies Cache-Control, Pragma, Expires and Surrogate-Control headers to the GDPR export attachment.
src/app/api/gdpr/delete-request/route.ts requires trusted origin, authentication, active organization, manage_settings RBAC, entitlement, gdpr_delete step-up and literal confirmation.
buildGdprDeletePlan preserves subscriptions, billing_metadata, audit_events and audit_logs while planning eligible customer data deletion/anonymization.
gdpr_export_requested, gdpr_export_denied, gdpr_delete_requested and gdpr_delete_denied events are recorded with sanitized metadata and request context.
docs/privacy/DATA_PROCESSING_OVERVIEW.md and dashboard privacy copy explicitly avoid unsupported claims such as automatic downstream hard deletion or immutable audit-chain deletion.

coverageClaims: delete preserves legal, billing and audit-chain records
GDPR audit metadata avoids raw token material
tests.manualReviewNote: Connector patch was prepared in GitHub. CI/runtime execution should run npm run test, npm run typecheck and npm run security:ci before production release.

knownLimitations: Delete request route creates a retention-aware pending review plan; final destructive deletion/anonymization remains an approved operational workflow.
Binary document export and downstream processor deletion are not claimed by this evidence unless separately implemented.
